set.body:
Replace the growing FitPlanExecutor engine match with a typed FitInterpreter abstraction. Built-in engines become method values plus given interpreters. Keep current public fit APIs as compatibility wrappers.

Acceptance: OLS, GLS, LSS, and runwise behavior remains unchanged; existing fit JVM/JS tests pass; unsupported engines fail through typed FitError; no mutable registry is introduced in shared code.
set.title: Refactor fit execution into typed interpreters
